root_cause.text: The ath12k driver failed to filter out secondary links when configuring Wake-on-Wireless (WoW) offloads in Multi-Link Operation (MLO) mode, causing the WCN7850 firmware to crash upon receiving invalid offload configurations on non-primary links.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds conditional checks `if (arvif != &arvif->ahvif->deflink) continue;` in `drivers/net/wireless/ath/ath12k/wow.c` functions like `ath12k_wow_cleanup` and `ath12k_wow_set_wakeups`, restricting WoW operations to the default link (`deflink`) as required to prevent the firmware crash described in the CVE.
